text:
Aisha (CS): Hey team — PioneerPay (launching their BNPL pilot) needs a few config tweaks for their Brazil + Canada rollout next Tue 09:00 UTC. Asking for: 1) temporary QPS bump on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings, 2) an IP allowlist for a set of edge CIDRs, and 3) a region pin to use eu-west1 for Brazil traffic and northamerica-northeast1 for Canada. Can eng/sre confirm feasibility and rollback plan?

Andrés (PioneerPay): Thanks Aisha — traffic will be highest on checkout tokenization (/v1/generate) and embedding lookups for fraud model. Expected steady QPS 150 -> spike to ~800 for ~45m on warmup. IPs coming from our CDN: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/25. Launch is low-risk but timing is fixed. Need to avoid 429s.

Dina (Acct Mgr): Also flag: PioneerPay renewal is in ~18 days. They want to see smooth launch as part of commercial check-in. Happy to join post-mortem if anything.

Leo (Eng): Quick feasibility check: we can do temporary qps bump via per-customer rate profile and add CIDRs to allowlist. Region pinning mapping -> route by source geo can be sticky; easiest is route by customer tag to dedicated pool in the requested regions. Two questions: do they need dedicated capacity or ok with a soft-priority bump?

Andrés (PioneerPay): Soft-priority bump is fine as long as 99th pct latency stays <250ms for /v1/generate. If we see high error rate, we should auto-fallback to a smaller model.

Ravi (SRE): I can provision a temporary rate profile and add the CIDRs. Need approval for dedicated slot allocation from capacity team if we reserve GPUs. If not reserving, we'll rely on routing priority and cache. Recommend: 1) create a short-lived dedicated burst pool for 2 hours around launch, 2) autoscale down after.

Aisha (CS): @Leo @Ravi ok to proceed with the short-lived dedicated burst pool for launch window? PioneerPay wants the safety net. Also can we schedule a canary ~30m before main launch at 08:30 UTC?

Leo (Eng): Yes. I'll prepare the config and a rollback runbook. Canary looks good. Planning checklist: - create customer rate-profile cid:pioneerpay-prod - attach allowlist entries - spin up burst pool: dedicated-pioneerpay-burst-2h - set fallback model chain (gpt-medium -> gpt-small) if errors >3% in 5m.

Ravi (SRE): Created internal ticket INF-7821 for the burst pool and allowlist work. ops-bot: created incident/ticket message.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-7821 created by Ravi. Assigned: Leo, Ravi. SLA: P2.

Leo (Eng): Draft config (will apply via infra deploy):
```json
{
  "customer_id": "pioneerpay-prod",
  "rate_profile": {"steady_qps": "150", "burst_qps": "900", "window_minutes": "120"},
  "allowlist": ["203.0.113.0/24", "198.51.100.0/25"],
  "region_routing": {"brazil": "eu-west1", "canada": "northamerica-northeast1"},
  "fallback_chain": ["gpt-medium", "gpt-small"],
  "canary_time": "2026-03-17T08:30:00Z",
  "launch_time": "2026-03-17T09:00:00Z"
}
```

Andrés (PioneerPay): config looks good to me. We'll monitor metrics on our side. Can you add an event hook to post a short telemetry ping to our ops channel every 1m during the 2h window?

Aisha (CS): Noted — Leo/Ravi can we add a webhook to push success/failure pings to https://hooks.pioneerpay.io/redwood-launch (auth token provided via secret manager)?

Ravi (SRE): Yes — will wire webhook with secret via vault and ensure retries. Also adding a pre-launch smoke test: 50 synthetic requests over 5m to check latency/error baselines. Rollback triggers: any sustained 5m error rate >3% or 95th latency >500ms.

Dina (Acct Mgr): I'll surface this to renewals lead and schedule a short executive post-launch sync for next day. Good luck team :rocket:

Leo (Eng): Will apply as a canary deploy at 08:30, then full rollout at 09:00. Plan posted in INF-7821. Post-launch actions: collect token-level cost delta, p95 latency, and sample outputs for quality checks.

Andrés (PioneerPay): Appreciate it — we'll standby in the ops channel. If anything goes sideways we may request extension of the burst window.

Aisha (CS): Thanks all. I'll update the PioneerPay ticket with the plan and add the renewal note. Follow-up call scheduled for 2026-03-18 14:00 UTC.

Leo (Eng): One last note — please confirm the auth header we should accept from PioneerPay for the webhook (we'll validate HMAC). Andrés?

Andrés (PioneerPay): We'll use X-Pioneer-Signature HMAC-SHA256, token shared via secrets. Confirmed.

Ravi (SRE): All set from infra side. Will post a pre-launch checklist reminder 1h before.

Aisha (CS): Closing thread for now, will reopen if any blockers.
